description: Defines structures and enums related to tensor metadata and parameter metadata for AOTI in PyTorch's inductor, including TensorMetadata, ParameterTag, ParameterMetadata, and related functions.

classes.name: TensorMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata of a tensor, including shape, dtype, device, and symbolic info.

classes.name: ParameterMetadata
classes.description: Represents metadata of input parameters for aten operations, including type, value, and order.

methods.name: TensorMetadata::build_guard
methods.description: Builds a guard/TensorCheck for the tensor based on its metadata.

methods.name: TensorMetadata::operator==
methods.description: Compares two TensorMetadata objects for equality.

methods.name: ParameterMetadata::operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two ParameterMetadata objects.
